unavailable_fields.per_collective_pcie_nvlink_bytes: No collectives exist in this workload; device_telemetry would only give device-wide NVML rates in native windows, not per-op bytes, and PCIe/NVLink traffic is not inferred from payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.cross_rank_clock_alignment: Only rank 0 exists; observations.json ranks status not_applicable 'single-device task'.

rationale: Frozen objective is ttft_ms on the single-GPU eager Qwen3-4B interactive row; the observed uncertainty is the rejected decision reason paired_gain_not_above_noise (candidate 26.70 ms vs paired parent 28.09 ms, ~1.4 ms delta) on an additive bundle whose binding resolved to direct with 'no functional replacements' (2 candidate invocations, 0 framework fallbacks). Three collectors target that uncertainty on this exact candidate in separate workers: candidate_diagnostics to establish what the candidate's native invocations actually execute and how their prefill kernel/op composition differs from the parent; execution_timeline for a clean trace of the prefill->first-token window bracketed by the two explicit torch.cuda.synchronize() calls, with CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, per-device intervals and gpu-busy fraction to decide whether remaining TTFT headroom is GPU compute or host dispatch gaps (its CPU-submission clock bounds cannot prove GPU readiness, listed unavailable); binding_cost because a candidate exists and the bundle does not replace the parent, giving clean AB/BA parent vs binding-only passthrough whole-invocation cost with quality checks to bound the additive binding overhead and judge whether the ~1.4 ms delta is structural or noise. Excluded with reasons: nccl_tuning and collective_calibration (no process group, no NCCL, no collectives in the measured unit); nsys (parent torch trace already associated all 66441 kernels with 0 unassociated and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, and no overlap, CUDA-graph or attribution question remains); device_telemetry (device-wide NVML sampling cannot attribute per-op behavior and no PCIe/communication question exists for resident weights); python_runtime (perturbing cProfile cannot resolve a noise-level delta and host-gap structure is covered by execution_timeline).
